1934, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5,
Page 188 Cont.
Apr. 16 Mary Clarke - 42 - slight stroke lost speech ...... can say some words O.K.
Edith Stolinski - 30 - tragic accident in Erie, Pa., in Park watching fireworks & listening to music. One fire-piece went wild and struck her arm and sister's face. Arm badly torn-pneumonia followed and then T.B. Now in Detroit for ten yrs. Brother to be ordained in May - 1st Mass June 3rd ... Enrolled $3.00
John Sanders - 52 - 4 in Fam. cannot swallow - canc. .?
Mrs. Bety Morgan - 92 - non C. dislocated hip or nerv. or ...???
17 Vincent Welch - about 30 - mastoid operation arranged for to-mor- row - is enrolled at 9:50P.M. 50c. Came back to Wed. devotions next day at 8 -- phones Wed. 25th improving fine. Sunday 29 En- rolls perpetually. Drs. astonished - no operation, mastoid quite healed by itself. Deo Gratias
Page 189 Apr. 19 Helen Volkman - 19 -
Mrs. C. Chandler - 68 - fears (Womb) operation.
20 Richard Clinton 17, Enrolled by phonefor fractured skull .. roller .. skates (9 a.m.) ...... 9:30 p.m. reported "conscious".
Eliz G. Drean - 9 - 127 1bs some ago - fear some organs ..... intel- ligent alert, etc.
Mrs. Gorman - 74 - cataracts - Sister - 80 Jan. 1 cataract (Rose Markley) lost toes gangreen's.
Joseph F. Westrick - 61 - inward Goiter ... as not been able to work in 2 yrs ... operat'n.
Girl Wanted - house cleaning Wechter- 3740 Belvidere (near Mack)
24 M. Sullivan - 64 - to have leg amputated at 8a.m. Is enrolled at 6 a.m.
Howard Schnel - 33 - a wife & 2 depend. on him - looking for work. Eliz. Dreaden - 44 - goiter - lump gone from breast ....
Rita M. Bishop - 14 - appendicitis .... Jerry Gildea - 46 - mental & spinal.
